sections.name: Phase 1's exit: four fresh reviewers on the newest packaged build found all four exits not met. Close phase 1 with each open fault carried into this week's phase 2 items?

detail: Gone since 22 October: the office packaged and walked; Tom complete (face, jacket, jeans, boots); Tom sits and stands; both speakers turn; the voice inside the game with no prepared openings; Rita's wear and night window; the puddles and the hill; and this morning Ron and Darren dressed in the packaged game.

B, the speakers: nobody but Tom sits; Darren's feet slip up to 45 cm; people inside the office cannot walk out of it, so Ron misses the street. Into Ron end to end and people alive, this week.
C, speech: 2.02 s against the 2.0 s bar on the agreed run (1.78 s as shipped, slow replies up to 8.2 s); three tries spent, so it waits, measured again with Ron's paid talk runs.
D, headroom: card memory just over the 6 GB line while walking, little card time spare, 58.4 fps on the build machine. Phase 2's first item.
options: Yes, close it and carry the faults (recommended)
